answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using time-locked collateral bonds. Each agent must deposit stake into protocol escrow, which slashes funds if malicious behavior is proven. An attacker incurs a verifiable capital lockup and liquidity cost per persona, preventing a hollow swarm from manipulating consensus without immense financial reserves. However, steep deposit requirements turn the network into a walled garden, leaving low-capital agents stranded on an economic island.
